question.problem:
What is the index of the term $640$ for the geometric sequence below?

$$
f(n+1)=4f(n),\,f(1)=10,\,n\ge 1
$$
question.worked_solution:
This geometric sequence is given as a recurrence relation, i.e.,

$$
f(n+1)=r\cdot f(n).
$$

Therefore:

$$
f(1)=10,\,r=4.
$$

We're interested in finding $n$ such that $f(n)=640.$ Using the formula for the $n$th term, we get:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(n) & =f(1)\cdot {r}^{n-1} \\ 640 & =10\cdot {4}^{n-1} \\ \frac{640}{10} & ={4}^{n-1} \\ 64 & ={4}^{n-1} \\ {4}^{3} & ={4}^{n-1}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the exponents gives:

$$
3=n-1\,⟹\,n=4
$$

Therefore, $640$ is the $4$th term of the sequence.
